newsitem.title: USA: FGIC quaifies four muni issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: FGIC quaifies four muni issues for insurance.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Co. on Monday said that it qualified for bond insurance the following four municipal bond issues, which will be sold competitively today.
--Merriam, Kan., $5 million general obligation improvement bonds.
--Traverse Area Pub, Mich., $15 million school building bonds.
--North Richland Hills, Texas, $4.1 million limited tax GOs bonds.
--North Richland Hills, Texas, $2.755 million certificate of participation revenue bonds. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
